description: This Java source file defines the CompareImagesForm class, a GUI component for comparing images and their associated tables within the RomRaider project. It provides functionality to select images, compare their tables, and display differences with color-coded indicators.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm
classes.description: A JFrame-based GUI for comparing images and their tables within the RomRaider application, including selection, comparison, and display of differences.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm$ComboBoxRenderer
classes.description: Custom renderer for JComboBox items, displaying Rom file names.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm$ChangeListCellRenderer
classes.description: Custom renderer for list items showing table comparison results with color coding.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm$ListItem
classes.description: Data class representing a list item with a type and value, used for displaying comparison results.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm$TableTreeNode
classes.description: Represents a node containing a table and its associated frame in the comparison tree.

methods.name: CompareImagesForm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI components, populating combo boxes, and setting up event listeners.

methods.name: findAndShowTable
methods.description: Finds a table by name within a Rom and displays it in the editor.

methods.name: populateComboBoxes
methods.description: Populates the image selection combo boxes with available Rom objects.

methods.name: compareTables
methods.description: Compares tables between two Rom objects, updating the UI with differences and status.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles button click events to trigger table comparison.
